n8.why: F2a is an FTIR of fillers and PCM; the Diels-Alder crosslinking into the PU network is a mechanism stated in linked text, not shown by any panel.

a1.why: The dashed 732 cm-1 line meets the F-d@Ce trace on its broad maximum with no dip; the reader took the guide label for a peak.

n10.why: F2d shows flat, thin, edge-on stacked sheets (MXene lamellae) with particles between; the reader called the sheet edges rods.

n11b.why: F3d shows PCM0.5 (~920%) and PCM1 (~860%) breaking later than mPU (~835%), so a monotonic fall with filler content rests on Table 1/text only.

o8b.why: Break strains read from F3d match the label (mPU ~835%, PCM2(Ce) ~700%, PCM5 ~650%); the reader wrongly called mPU the shortest.

o10.why: Top and middle Bode-modulus rows show the mPU trace flat near zero and filled coatings plateauing ~0.4-2 GOhm cm2; the reader ignored the mPU axis label and the 60-day row.
